summary_1line: During King Sagara’s sacrifice, a disguised rakshasa steals the sacred horse, prompting his sixty thousand sons to scour and dig the earth in search of it.

image_candidates.scene_text: A demon in disguise stealthily carries away the consecrated sacrificial horse while priests shout in alarm near the royal altar.
King Sagara commands his sixty thousand sons as they prepare to scour the world to recover the stolen sacrificial horse.
Thousands of princes dig into the earth with ploughs and diamond‑sharp nails as the ground trembles and serpents and demons scatter.
